area: Keystone testbed: arena nav plan from pathfinding + navigation

find.report_claim: pathfinding and navigation were two of the 21 Keystone modules the shooter had never imported, even though the shipped arena publishes cover boxes, a spawn and a surge pickup — all the data a nav plan needs
find.live_evidence: the sim has a SpatialGrid for wall colliders but no world-level route answer for an AI/soak consumer; feeding a route into movement would change the replay hash
find.consumer_evidence: NavGrid is plain data, A* is deterministic with fixed neighbour order and tie-breaking, and PathFollower/navigation_report turn the route into a JSON-safe waypoint state

read: shooter/data/levels.json: arena size 40, seven covers, spawn (0,0.9,8), pickup (0,0.5,-6)
killed: driving sim movement with the follower: that would change combat, RNG and the b25db520 replay hash
computing the grid each frame: cycle 180 measured the cost of per-frame scene queries, so this is an on-demand query
hardcoding a route: the point of the consumer is that a designer editing the covers changes the plan
analyze.survivor: an on-demand nav_plan_report() that derives a 1 m NavGrid from the shipped covers, runs diagonal A* spawn -> pickup, smooths cells to world waypoints and exposes both path and follower reports

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py imports the pathfinding and navigation APIs and adds nav_plan_report(); tests/test_keystone_navigation_mechanics.py (5 tests) pins route shape, blocked covers, world waypoint endpoints, a blocked-goal not-found result and sim isolation; README testbed matrix and tree name both modules and the test

shooter.failing_first: all 5 new tests failed with AttributeError: 'ShooterGame' object has no attribute 'nav_plan_report'
shooter.own_test_bug: the first draft asserted waypoint count equals cell path length; smooth_path legitimately collapsed 15 cells to 2 waypoints, so the assertion was corrected to 0 < n <= cells
shooter.measured: 40x40 grid, 143 blocked cells, A* found=True, 14 steps, cost 14.0, 15 expanded, smoothed to waypoints (0.5,0,8.5) and (0.5,0,-5.5)
shooter.mutation: replacing the cover-block marking with a no-op fails 2 of 5 tests (blocked cells and blocked-goal route); game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 5623aa167c5f67c8e6b379b3a5ddb3161d0aa9f1a4cd788b35251ec8d7f8426d)
